title: Module 8: Online & Distance Learning Design
description: Design defensible online courses using Moore's three types of interaction and the Community of Inquiry model, and choose modes (asynchronous, synchronous, hybrid) deliberately.
learning_objectives: Allocate Moore's three interaction types (learner-content, learner-instructor, learner-learner) intentionally across an online course.
Apply the Community of Inquiry model (cognitive, social, teaching presence) to diagnose deep-learning gaps.
Match mode (asynchronous, synchronous, hybrid) to objective rather than treating mode as a default.
